name: John McPhail
sources: Ancestry.com, Washington, U.S., Death Records, 1907–2017, and Select Death Index, 1907–1960
Find a Grave, memorial 6749130 (via Ancestry.com, U.S., Find a Grave Index)
Ancestry.com, public member tree of Ed Simons (tree 189265374)
notes: Father of John Belle McPhail, named on his son's 1925 death record.
Find a Grave lists his other children as Byrd Newman McPhail (1833–1893), William Dugald McPhail (1838–1900), Mary Rebecca McPhail Gudger (1840–1924) and Daniel Percell McPhail (1847–1928).
Ed Simons's tree gives John David McPhail's birth as about 1805 in Cumberland County, North Carolina, and his death as before 1870 in McMinn County, Tennessee.
